title: Perf/host overhead
body:
Fix | Before | After
-- | -- | --
Aborting 1000 requests at once, 100k waiting (10k waiting: 113 ms → 1.9 ms) | 1.41 s | 7.6 ms
Scheduler time per decode step, 100k waiting (10k waiting: 0.90 → 0.71 ms) | 2.02 ms | 0.83 ms
Queue statistics on steps that aren’t logged (they were walking the whole waiting queue every step) | 1.7–1.9 ms at 100k waiting | 0
LLM.generate output loop per step (1024 sequences, MTP 5) | 4.1–4.8 ms | 2.1–2.3 ms
